description: [Jobs] Get full details for a Trackly job ID returned by search or your saved queue. Match scores are saved results only. For a missing score, explain matchScoreReason; parse_required/score_required are prerequisites; only matchScoreStatus=pending confirms owned waiting parse or score work, outside_scoring_window is outside the automatic 30-day window, description_unavailable means no usable description, inactive means a closed posting, and not_scored is unknown. Missing or closed postings return availability=unavailable with retryable=false and a next step; do not retry that ID. Failures include a category and retry guidance.

context.description: Briefly explain why this tool helps the current job-search goal. Never include resume text, profile answers, demographic or work-authorization answers, application notes, credentials, or secrets.

id.description: Positive numeric Trackly job ID from trackly_search_jobs or your saved queue, not an employer requisition ID or URL. Correct invalid arguments before retrying.
